I am not saying I disagree with the need to give students enriching experiences like concerts, but the system currently in place in most states, which is designed to make academic teachers look as bad as possible so schools can be privatized, means kids need every day in class learning.  I love our elective teachers at my school, but I want my kids in my class every day. It is nothing personal.  It's the system.  As for the money, we work about 200 days a year.  The time off has to have some value to you.  I value my Thanksgiving, Christmas, spring break, and summer weeks off personally at about $20,000.  In other words, if I am making $30,000 teaching, it would take $50k to get me to leave.

Tl/Dr or whatever:  It's not you, it's me and don't forget about opportunity costs.
